It is important to remember that the border is not a simple issue of "security" or "enforcement." It is a complex issue that involves the interplay of economic, political, and social factors. It is not simply a matter of "getting tough" on immigration or "building a wall."

Instead, we need to look at the underlying causes of migration and seek out solutions that are humane and effective.
